gaps.title: Evidence confidence is asserted, not derived
gaps.detail: All 1,499 evidence rows fall in a single confidence band (high), which means whatever wrote them set one value rather than deriving it from the source.
gaps.whyItMatters: Confidence is an input to every reasoning step downstream. A constant carries no information, so it cannot separate strong evidence from weak, and every confidence-weighted figure in the system is effectively unweighted.
gaps.closedWhen: Evidence confidence varies with source reliability and freshness at the point of ingestion.
gaps.reachBasis: all 1,499 evidence rows share one band

components.basis: a banded group-by over every evidence row

gaps.title: 1 detected risks, none registered or owned
gaps.detail: Every risk on this organization's register was derived on read from its operational records. None has been written to hpbrain_risks, so none has an owner, a mitigation, or a review date.
gaps.whyItMatters: A derived risk is a finding. Until it is registered it cannot be assigned, tracked, or closed, and nothing distinguishes a risk somebody decided to accept from one nobody has seen.
gaps.closedWhen: The risks the organization accepts as real exist as rows in hpbrain_risks with an owner and a mitigation.
gaps.reachBasis: none of the 1 detected risks is registered

components.basis: a row count over the risk register
the count is exact; the consequence weighting attached to this kind of absence is a stated modelling judgement, not a measurement
structural finding — an absent table has no population to measure over

gaps.title: 1499 of 1499 evidence rows carry no observation date
gaps.detail: The rows record when they were ingested but not when the thing they describe was observed, so their true age is unknown.
gaps.whyItMatters: Evidence freshness decays on a 90-day half-life, and freshness weights every corroboration. Undated evidence has to be weighted by its ingestion date instead, which overstates how current it is when a historical file is loaded.
gaps.closedWhen: observed_date is populated on every evidence row, from the source record rather than from the import time.

evidence.what: evidence rows with no observation date

method.severity: severity = reach x consequence x 5, on a 0-5 scale. Reach is measured from the records. Consequence is fixed per gap kind, so it cannot be adjusted per instance.
method.consequence: Set by the kind of absence: absences that make a class of conclusion impossible rank above ones that degrade a figure, which rank above ones that narrow coverage.

derivation.method: Every figure is computed deterministically by SQL aggregation over this organization's own rows, on read.
derivation.llm: No language model contributed to any figure, ranking, category or conclusion in this response.
derivation.scope: Every query is filtered to tenant_id = 8. No aggregate crosses organizations.
derivation.liveness: Cached against a fingerprint of the source data rather than a clock, so a change to the organization's records invalidates it immediately.
